meta.title: Related Rates 1 V2
meta.prompt: Match the mathematical expressions on the left to the corresponding statements about changing quantities in a saltwater tank on the right. All quantities are functions of time, \(t\) (min), defined as follows: \(V(t)\) Volume of water in a tank (\(\text{m}^3\)) at time, \(t\) \(C(t)\) Concentration of salt in a tank (\(\text{kg/m}^3\)) at time, \(t\) Directions: Drag one or more \(\text{cards}\), on the left, onto a single \(\text{slot}\), on the right. It is possible that some \(\text{cards}\) may not be used. \(\small\text{Cards}\) \(\small\text{Slots}\)

zone_labels.drop1: After 1 minute, the tank contains \(0.7 \text{ m}^3\) of water.
zone_labels.drop2: After 3 minutes, the tank contains \(1.2 \text{ m}^3\) of water, but drains at \(0.7 \text{ m}^3\)/min.
zone_labels.drop3: The salt concentration at \(t = 3\) is \(0.8 \text{ kg/m}^3\)
zone_labels.drop4: Initially, the tank has no salt. After 1 minute, salt is added, increasing the concentration by \(0.02 \text{ kg/m}^3\) per minute.
zone_labels.drop5: At \(t=1\), the tank is filling by \(0.1 \text{ m}^3\)/min.
